rubric_policy: Exact original rubric and ordered levels; no tuning after human labels.
pool: Current source pipeline using the production scheduled-profile configuration plus existing CUSTOM_CONFIG. Freeze retrieval date, source config hash and canonical pool IDs privately before any Decisions request. No production workflow or delivery-history writes.

eligibility.abstract: Complete nonempty public abstract only, no title-only scoring, no truncation; bound and exclusions recorded.
eligibility.exclude_duplicates: Canonical DOI/related DOI; arXiv IDs without versions; ChemRxiv DOI base without version; normalized-title exact and token-Dice >=0.90, including comparisons with all five development titles.
eligibility.report: Per-source counts for fetched, missing/overbound abstracts, development matches, duplicates, eligible and sampled. No hiding missingness.

sampling.seed_basis: SHA256 of this frozen protocol and each canonical paper ID; no handpicking.

strata_in_order.rule: Round-robin source groups; deterministic hash draw within each group.
Round-robin configured direction indices; hash draw within each direction winner bin upper keyword-cosine quartile.
Near-topic candidates: upper-half keyword cosine intersect middle-half current-baseline rank; deterministic hash draw.

sampling.overlap: Each paper selected once; exhausted strata filled by remaining eligible papers in deterministic hash order and exact shortfall/fallback recorded.
sampling.insufficient_pool: Stop if fewer than 24 eligible unique papers. Do not alter rules to seek favorable cases.
sampling.scope_note: Stratified pilot; within-pool metrics are not estimates of unselected feed prevalence.

baseline.strategy: Read actual multi_interest_profile settings, current keyword/Zotero weights and path filters from existing private runtime configuration; no legacy_mean or keyword-only substitute.
baseline.code: Use current production LocalReranker.rerank with pinned model/revision and default experiments; compare the same 24 full abstracts.
baseline.credentials: Only existing Actions ZOTERO_ID/ZOTERO_KEY and CUSTOM_CONFIG references; availability not yet runtime-verified.
baseline.privacy: Actual corpus and collection paths in memory only; hash the filtered ordered profile snapshot privately, never serialize or send corpus to OpenAI.
baseline.fails_closed: Missing credentials/config, empty filtered Zotero corpus, wrong strategy/backend or inaccessible pinned weights block paid comparison.

decisions.batching: Deterministic greedy groups of at most four, split before calls if the existing conservative byte-token bound exceeds 272000. At most 24 requests, no automatic retry; reserve the sum of all planned bounds under the original global cap before the first request.
decisions.explanations: Decisions scores/distributions only; no generated explanation claims.
decisions.private_delivery_gate: No paid request until a usable authorized private result channel exists.

accounting.slot: One explicitly authorized held-out pilot; preserve exact v1 original claim and completed v2 slot; do not reopen/reset them.
accounting.unknown_usage: Keep conservative reservation and halt; no blind retry, new arbitrary claim ID or unrecorded spend.
accounting.records: Measured input/cache-read/cache-write/output/reasoning usage, model, currency/price version, estimated spend versus reservation and unknown usage. No invoice verification claim.

blind_pack.order: Independent random private shuffle; IDs unrelated to score, model, source group or selection stratum.
show: short factual evidence-preserving paraphrase or explicitly permitted abstract
blind_pack.storage: Private delivery only; no plaintext public Actions artifacts or logs. Raw newly fetched abstracts remain runtime temp only.

evaluation_after_labels.require: Every sampled ID explicitly labeled 0,1,2,3; missing/unclicked is never negative.
evaluation_after_labels.precision_at_10: Relevant = label >= 2; compare the same candidate set and frozen rankings.
evaluation_after_labels.ndcg_at_10: Gain 2**label - 1; discount log2(rank+1); report undefined if all gains zero.
evaluation_after_labels.coverage: Report source composition of pool, sample and each top 10 plus direction coverage privately.
evaluation_after_labels.limits: Small pilot, no held-out label access until frozen predictions; no deployment or definitive validation claim.
